text:
Maya: post-release quickcheck — orchestra synthetic suite (us-west) showing unexpected tail latency. p95 ~1850ms vs baseline ~200ms and intermittent 502s on KV probe for route /v1/orchestra (model v3.2.1).

Deploy-bot: Canary finished 12m ago. No automatic rollback triggered.

Maya: tagging @jon @alix — propose HOLD remaining rollout and pin traffic back to v3.2.0 until we triage.

Jon: ack, pulling traces and p95 histograms now. Seeing spike coincident with warmup on kv-host-14.

Alix: observability: https://go.redwood/obs/trace/abc123 — KV probe 502s cluster at 16:12 UTC, host-14 GC pauses visible.

Sara: can we repro with a targeted synthetic run limited to affected hosts and model header set?

Maya: yes. smokebot, please run targeted synth:
```
curl -i 'https://synth.redwood/api/check?route=orchestra&variant=embed' \
  -H 'x-region: us-west' \
  -H 'x-model: v3.2.1' \
  -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'
```
Run 50 reqs across host-12..host-16.

Deploy-bot: starting targeted synthetic job 1759218604-rt1 (50 reqs across host-12..host-16).

Deploy-bot: job complete — results: 3/50 requests returned 502s, p95=1850ms, median=120ms.

Jon: consistent with initial spike. Tail and 502s concentrated on host-14. Heap growth observed before the spike.

Maya: decision: pin traffic to v3.2.0 (no full rollback) to stop customer impact while we collect dumps. Notify status.

Alix: preparing config change to pin: set canary weight v3.2.1 -> 0%, v3.2.0 -> 100%, and keep artifacts for investigation. Estimated switch <2m.

Mara: reminder — change window until 21:00 UTC; will coordinate if we need extended work.

Maya: procedural checklist:
- pin traffic to v3.2.0
- notify #status and customers (if SLOs hit)
- collect heapdumps + jemalloc stats from host-14
- re-run synthetic sweep post-pin to validate
- open runtime bug and assign

Sara: I'll take heapdumps and start jemalloc stats collection now. Posting commands in case others need them:
```
sudo gcore -o /var/dumps/process $(pidof orchestra)
jemalloc_ps_dump > /var/dumps/jemalloc.json
```

Jon: starting trace collection, grabbing full pprof and logs for host-14.

Maya: executing traffic pinning now.

Deploy-bot: Traffic rebalanced — v3.2.1 weight set to 0%. v3.2.0 now receives 100% traffic. No automatic rollback performed (pin applied).

Deploy-bot: note: retained v3.2.1 artifact for debugging.

Alix: will open bug RED-1248 with traces + heapdumps, assigned to runtime/perf. Include synthetic job id 1759218604-rt1 in notes.

Maya: done. Moving to a postmortem thread and will update status channel if SLOs change. Thanks all for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

Jon: +1, will keep watching and post a follow-up in the morning with deeper analysis.

Sara: heapdumps uploaded to s3://redwood-dumps/1759218604/host-14/.

Maya: closing this kick-off thread — follow-up in RED-1248 and the postmortem doc.
